title: The Hengyu Divine Furnace
summary: Jiang Taixu has been rescued, but his life force is nearly spent and he lies in the Jiang family's Dragon Transformation Pool while enemies from 4,000 years ago close in. Ye Fan presents himself to Jiang Yun, and when Doctor Wang Shen says the family's medicines are exhausted, Ye Fan gives up the crystal of the True Dragon Immortal Medicine, which should revive the Divine King in three hours. As attackers break the Great Emperor formation, Ye Fan rejects retreat or negotiation and proposes a Source Arts deception: fake divine-source mist, illusory formation flags and a deliberate opening, all backed by the Hengyu Divine Furnace. The trap splits the enemy's thirteen Holy Lords and lets the Jiang reactivate the Great Emperor formation. Three Old Demons (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven), corpses twisted by eating Yinming grass, then go for Jiang Taixu. Ye Fan holds them off with the God-Beating Whip, which strikes divine sense, until Fairy Caiyun of the Wanchu Holy Land (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) appears.
